final_message:
I've drafted the Bluebird Bakery Co report for September 2026 for the reviewer. The script computed all the figures; I wrote the 8 commentary bullets in section 1, and the DRAFT banner is still in place.

**Files** (in `evals/runs/v4-run-20261013/g_bb_no_ttm/skill_output/`):
- `bluebird-bakery-co-2026-09-trends.md`: the draft report
- `bluebird-bakery-co-2026-09-trends.json`: the full analysis, which every figure comes from

**Data quality: 1 mismatch.** In Mar 2026, the 'Total for Professional Services' line in the workbook says 2,225.00, but its detail rows add up to 2,200.00. The report uses the detail rows, and the reviewer needs to decide which figure is right. Two other things are noted in the commentary:
- 'Charitable Donations' has no values and no total line. It was treated as a blank account, and the 4 rows after it were kept at the parent level rather than grouped under it.
- 'Total Delivery' has no section heading. It was grouped from the 2 rows above it because they add up to it in every month.

**No TTM or year-over-year comparisons.** The export covers only 9 months (Jan–Sep 2026), and the commentary says so.

**Key points:**
- **Revenue:** 81,300, up 17.7% on August (69,050) and 17.3% above the prior 6-month average (69,292). This includes a new stream, Wholesale Accounts, at 12,000; it is zero in every earlier month.
- **Gross margin:** 65.3%, up from 59.6% in August (+5.7 points). That's the highest in the period.
- **Costs:** Operating expenses rose 21.0% to 31,570, mainly because Wages & Salaries went from 16,000 to 21,000 after being 16,000 in every earlier month. The reviewer needs to confirm whether that's a one-off or the new monthly level.
- **Cash:** Bank Accounts fell to 37,600, down 1,800 on August and 10,800 on six months earlier (48,400), even though net income (21,553 in September) was positive in every month. The export doesn't show why.

Mystery Shopper Program shows as "from 0" in the movers table, but it was also 400 in March and June. The commentary says it is not a new line.

**Uncategorised accounts:** Instagram Ads, Mystery Shopper Program and Supplier Rebates matched no category rule, so they're in **Other Opex**.
